name: Rose
source:
The diva of the Amaryllis nightclub.
She has a somewhat brusque personality.
She used to have a crush on Francis.
She was once the mistress of politician Xin Guang, but her abortion of the child she was carrying provoked his anger and led to an attempt on her life.
Francis and Yvet save her life and she comes to rely on Yvet, but when she meets Lau Ming Wa, she unwittingly becomes a part of the plan to attack Francis.
